answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by making standing a sequential work chain, not a badge that can be bought. Each identity earns trust only by finishing linked jobs, each depending on the output of the last, like a raven carrying one message. The fable of trust fails here: splitting effort across fakes leaves every chain shallow and unrewarded, while a deep chain costs time no purchase can shortcut. A saffron merchant's standing grows through deliveries, and a violet stamp on each finished job marks progress no new identity can copy, so each new identity restarts the climb from zero.
